name: Zurich Airport

hours.quote: Die Betriebszeiten des Flughafens Zürich liegen zwischen 06:00 und 23:30 Uhr.

curfew.v: airport closed 23:30-06:00 unless an exemption permit is granted. Commercial flights may be planned until 23:00, delayed ones run until 23:30. Charter take-offs may be planned only until 22:00, delayed until 22:30. Non-commercial flights are in principle not allowed at night (federal environment office: 22:00-06:00)
curfew.quote: bis 23.00 Uhr geplant werden. ... Verspätete Starts und Landungen werden bis 23.30 Uhr ohne besondere Bewilligung zugelassen. ... Starts des Charterverkehrs dürfen nur bis 22.00 Uhr geplant werden. ... Verspätete Starts werden bis 22.30 Uhr ohne besondere Bewilligung zugelassen. ... Starts und Landungen des nichtgewerbsmässigen Verkehrs sind während der Nachtzeit grundsätzlich nicht gestattet.
curfew.also_quote: Les décollages et les atterrissages de vols non commerciaux sont interdits entre 22 heures et 6 heures.

runway.v: three runways: 16/34 3,700 m, 14/32 3,300 m and 10/28 2,500 m long (extensions of 28 and 32 approved, works not before 2030)
runway.quote: with the current system of three runways: 16/34 at 3'700 metres long, 14/32 at 3'300 metres long and 10/28 at 2'500 metres long.

slots.v: every IFR movement needs an airport slot before departure or arrival, including positioning, training and maintenance flights; IFR slots come via the dispatcher or handling agent (FBO)
slots.quote: Each IFR aircraft movement is required to previously obtain a mandatory airport slot; this includes positioning, training and flights into/out of maintenance facilities.

handling.v: operators must use one of the handling agents listed in AIP Switzerland for LSZH (unless self-handling is authorised); the airport names BHS Aviation Switzerland AG, Cat Air Service AG, Jet Aviation AG, Motorfluggruppe Zürich, SWISS PRIVILEGE AVIATION SERVICES GmbH and Travelcoup as business-aviation FBOs
handling.quote: Der Handling-Anbieter (FBO) ihrer Wahl kümmert sich um die gesamte Organisation ihres Fluges

deicing.v: de-icing by Swissport at the remote de-icing pads Charlie and Foxtrott (preferred) or on stand; dnata and Jet Aviation de-ice on stand only; Jet Aviation is the contact for business and general aviation
deicing.quote: Deicing operations at remote Deicing pads (RDP) are to be prioritised.

noise.v: noise charges by noise category; extra surcharges for take-offs and landings in the shoulder hours and at night (e.g. take-off 00:00-06:00 local carries the highest surcharge)
noise.quote: In addition, noise surcharges are applied depending on the shoulder hour or night time period.

fuel.v: fuel companies listed by the airport: BP, Colt, Enilive, Kuwait Petroleum Aviation, Shell, SOCAR, Swiss International AG, TotalEnergies and Vitol
fuel.quote: BP Europa SE ... Colt International Europe SARL ... Enilive Suisse S.A. ... Kuwait Petroleum Aviation (Switzerland) Ltd ... SHELL (Switzerland) AG ... SOCAR Energy Switzerland GmbH ... Swiss International AG ... TotalEnergies Aviation Suisse SA ... Vitol Aviation Switzerland AG
